copy.description: Read-only value with a copy-to-clipboard button.
copy.title: Copy widget

date.description: Calendar date without time. Input: HTML date. Display: plain text.
date.title: Date widget

datetime.description: Date and time. Wire format: RFC 3339. Input: datetime-local. Display: formatted instant.
datetime.title: Date-time widget

email.description: Email address. Input: HTML email. Display: mailto link.
email.title: Email widget

input.description: Generic text input. Extra properties pass through as HTML attributes.

type.description: HTML input type: text, password, email, search, tel, url, etc.

input.title: Native input widget

link.description: Anchor link. Text falls back to href. Accepts a single URL, an object, or an array.
link.title: Link widget

media.description: Image, video, or audio from a URL or array of assets.

layout.description: banner, full, hero: full-width (hides the property label). inline: normal flow.

media.title: Media widget

optionExpr.description: A value path, a {{template}}, or a fixed literal. String shorthand: dotted path if no braces, template if {{…}} present, literal otherwise.

oneOf.description: Shorthand path, template, or literal (see description).

path.description: Dotted path on this node's data.

optionExpr.title: Option expression

table.description: Display-only table of an array of objects. Sort reorders display only; wire order stays index order. Put this widget on the array field.

field.description: Property name or dotted path for the cell value.

fontWeight.description: CSS font-weight for the header and cells.

label.description: Header text. Defaults to the field name.

sortable.description: Header click toggles display sort. Default true.

sort.description: Initial display sort. Does not change the data array.

table.title: Table widget

tel.description: Phone number. Wire format: E.164. Input: HTML tel. Display: formatted number with tel: link.

countries.description: Restrict the flag picker to these ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. Omit for all countries.

defaultCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for flag picker and number parsing. Overrides the kit default.

showCountry.description: Show the flag and country typeahead. Default true.

tel.title: Telephone widget

description: Widget vocabulary for the default HTML kit. Each $defs entry defines the shape of a widget object when $kind points at it.
title: Surface default HTML kit — widget vocabulary
